sources.title: I Beg to Differ
sources.quote_checked: In order to outperform, your thinking has to be different and better. | First-level thinkers look for simple formulas and easy answers. | Second-level thinkers know that success in investing is the antithesis of simple. | the key to investment success has to lie in doing the opposite: in diverging from the crowd.

sources.title: The Indispensability of Risk
sources.quote_checked: Not being willing to take risks is an extremely risky strategy. | The risk inherent in not taking enough risk is very real. | The paradox of risk-taking is inescapable.

sources.title: Sea Change
sources.quote_checked: we never know where we're going, but we ought to know where we are. | We've gone from the low-return world of 2009-21 to a full-return world

sources.title: The Future as a Probability Distribution
sources.quote_checked: as a range of possibilities | as a probability distribution

sources.title: Howard Marks (investor)
sources.quote_checked: When I see memos from Howard Marks in my mail, they're the first thing I open and read.
